_comment: SCRUM-280 (#262): database states PEMS must upgrade from. One entry per release that reached a customer, demo or UAT database.
A release is its migration set: every migration of the current chain up to lastMigration, minus notIncluded
(migrations merged later with an older timestamp, which that release never had).
DatabaseUpgradePathSqlTests upgrades a copy of each to head and compares it with a fresh install;
MigrationCompatibilityRulesTests keeps the migrations of every listed release unchanged (released-migrations.sha256).
Add an entry when you ship (docs/deployment/CODE_FIRST_DATABASE.md, 'Supported releases'); keep at least the last three (N-2).
